newsitem.title: USA: America Online sees strong growth in Q2.
newsitem.headline: America Online sees strong growth in Q2.

text.p: America Online Inc Chief Executive Officer Steve Case said on Monday he expects "significant" subscriber growth in the fiscal second quarter ending in December.
Case, speaking to Reuters after a ceremony to mark the company's new listing on the New York Stock Exchange, said America Online also expects subscriber growth in the current (first) quarter.
Case reiterated that the company continues to have a goal of reaching 10 million subscribers by next summer. It currently has 6.2 million.
Case declined to discuss current-quarter earnings and revenues but said overall business was strong.
According to Zach's, analysts estimate first quarter earnings of $0.12 to $0.26 per share. with a mean estimate of $0.17.
AOL's premier on the NYSE drew a crowd to the trading post, where Case, following exchange tradition, bought the first 100 shares of the stock.
With above-average institutional interest, shares traded up 1/2 just 10 minutes after the session began.
The stock was up 7/8 to 27-7/8 at 1046 EDT/1446 GMT.
